RHHBY.title: Physicians and Patients Agree Lupus Care Is Improving, But Both Say Meaningful Gaps Remain
RHHBY.summary: Despite expanding biologic adoption and evolving treatment strategies for systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), research from Spherix Global Insights reveals substantial unmet need remains. While rheumatologists are advancing treatment strategies and increasing biologic utilization, nearly 80% of patients report moderate-to-severe disease with persistent symptoms and frequent flares. Approximately one-third of biologic-treated patients achieve only partial disease control. Recent approvals like Saphnelo® (anifrolumab) and anticipated approvals like Gazyva® (obinutuzumab) for non-renal SLE are expected to expand treatment options.

SYY.summary: Jordan Baptiste, Partner and President of Creative Fire (an Indigenous-owned strategy firm under Des Nedhe Group), has been named the 2026 Excellence in Indigenous Relations Award recipient by CCIB. The award recognizes his leadership in building partnerships between Indigenous Nations and corporate Canada, advancing reconciliation through Indigenous economic sovereignty, and integrating Indigenous ownership into business systems across energy, mining, infrastructure, and financial services sectors.

VERA.title: Vera Therapeutics Announces Appointment of Nancy Boman as Chief Regulatory Officer and Planned Retirement of William Turner
VERA.summary: Vera Therapeutics announced that William Turner, current Chief Regulatory Officer, will retire and transition to Strategic Advisor role in Q3 2026. Nancy Boman, M.D., Ph.D., with over 25 years of regulatory affairs experience, will succeed him. The transition follows the recent accelerated FDA approval of TRUTAKNA (atacicept-vymj), the company's first therapy for IgA nephropathy.

BYRN.title: Byrna Technologies Reports Fiscal Second Quarter 2026 Results
BYRN.summary: Byrna Technologies reported Q2 2026 net revenue of $16.4 million, down 43% year-over-year from $28.5 million, driven by weak e-commerce sales and slower retail reorders. The company took significant operational actions including reducing launcher production lines, exiting in-house ammunition manufacturing, and recording $10.4 million in non-cash impairment charges. Management expects fiscal 2026 will not be a growth year but anticipates improvement in H2 as marketing initiatives and retail expansion efforts gain traction.

BYRN.title: Byrna Technologies Selects Acceleration Partners to Expand Creator Network and Relaunch Affiliate Marketing Program
BYRN.summary: Byrna Technologies has partnered with Acceleration Partners to build a social creator network and relaunch its affiliate marketing program. The initiative aims to reach broader consumer audiences including women, families, and outdoor enthusiasts through creator-driven content on Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, with performance tracking across Byrna.com and Amazon ahead of the 2026 holiday season.

INAB.title: IN8bio Announces Publication in The Journal of Clinical Oncology Demonstrating DeltEx™ DRI Doubles Progression-Free Survival in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma
INAB.summary: IN8bio announced peer-reviewed clinical results from its Phase 1 trial of INB-200 (DeltEx DRI) published in The Journal of Clinical Oncology. The chemotherapy-resistant gamma-delta T cell therapy demonstrated a median progression-free survival of 16.1 months in repeat-dose patients, more than double the standard of care benchmark of 6.9 months, with no dose-limiting toxicities. The therapy showed a well-tolerated safety profile and median overall survival of 19.5 months in repeat-dose patients.

DNN.title: Foremost Clean Energy To Earn Majority Interest Across Athabasca Uranium Portfolio Under Denison Option Agreement
DNN.summary: Foremost Clean Energy has completed Phase 2 of its Option Agreement with Denison Mines, earning a 51% interest in 10 Athabasca uranium projects (35.78% in Hatchet Lake) by issuing 848,610 shares valued at $2 million and completing over $8 million in exploration expenditures. The milestone was achieved approximately 15 months ahead of the October 2027 deadline, with the company having made a new uranium discovery at Hatchet Lake and advanced multiple projects through drilling and geophysics.

NOW.summary: The global workflow automation market is projected to grow from $24.81 billion in 2025 to $64.88 billion by 2035 at a 10.09% CAGR. Cloud-based platforms and generative AI integration are driving expansion, with BFSI and healthcare as dominant sectors. PLD.title: Dimensional Fund Advisors Ltd. : Form 8.3 - PROLOGIS INC - Ordinary Shares
PLD.summary: Dimensional Fund Advisors Ltd. has disclosed a public opening position in Prologis Inc, holding 11,577,440 USD 0.01 common shares representing 1.24% of the company as of July 8, 2026. The disclosure includes a purchase of 406,142 shares at $47.2747 per share and a transfer in of 3,337 shares. Dimensional also made concurrent disclosures regarding Segro PLC.

EW.title: TRiCares Announces Initiation of TRICURE US IDE Pivotal Study for Topaz Tricuspid Valve Replacement System
EW.summary: TRiCares has enrolled the first patient in its TRICURE US IDE pivotal study for the Topaz tricuspid valve replacement system, marking the first randomized controlled trial comparing an investigational TTVR device against Edwards' commercially available EVOQUE system. The global study will involve up to 75 sites across the US, Canada, and Europe, with the goal of demonstrating safety and effectiveness for treating severe tricuspid regurgitation.

GPGI.title: Investigation Launched into GPGI, Inc. (NYSE: GPGI), Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP Encourages Investors and Potential Witnesses to Contact Law Firm
GPGI.summary: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP has launched an investigation into potential securities law violations by GPGI, Inc. The investigation was triggered after GPGI reported disappointing Q1 2026 results on May 7, 2026, with its Husky segment's Pro Forma Adjusted Net Sales declining 5.2% year-over-year to $290.8 million and Pro Forma Adjusted EBITDA falling 40.2% to $38 million. KBR.title: KBR Highlights Safety, Sustainability and Solutions in 2025 Sustainability and Corporate Responsibility Report
KBR.summary: KBR released its 2025 Sustainability and Corporate Responsibility Report, highlighting strong safety and sustainability performance with 35% sustainability-focused revenue, $2.7B in positive environmental impact, and a 0.033 total recordable incident rate. STJNY.summary: Stella-Jones Inc. (TSX: SJ) announced a conference call scheduled for August 6, 2026 at 10:00 AM EST to discuss Q2 2026 results. STJNY.summary: Stella-Jones Inc. announced a teleconference scheduled for August 6, 2026, at 10:00 AM EST to discuss its second quarter 2026 financial results. MGA.title: InStride’s Capability Accelerators Named “Best Professional Development Solution of the Year” in 8th Annual EdTech Breakthrough Awards
MGA.summary: InStride announced that its Capability Accelerators solution won the 'Best Professional Development Solution of the Year' award from EdTech Breakthrough. The cohort-based professional development programs help organizations close capability gaps through applied learning and AI-powered practice. A case study with Magna International showed 28% of participants advanced into leadership roles within months.

BC.summary: Brunswick Corporation will release its 2026 second quarter financial results on July 30, 2026, followed by a conference call at 10 a.m. CT. IVTJY.summary: Investec Bank plc, acting as Joint Broker to Gamma Communications Plc, disclosed public dealing in ordinary shares of Gamma Communications on 8th July 2026. FSM.summary: Fortuna Mining Corp. reported Q2 2026 production of 72,217 gold equivalent ounces, broadly in line with Q1 2026 and slightly above Q2 2025. Fortuna returned $80.2 million to shareholders through share repurchases and remains on track to achieve 2026 annual production guidance of 281,000-305,000 GEO.

SBFFY.title: Monaco Energy Boat Challenge sets sail with 54 teams driving sustainable innovation
SBFFY.summary: The 13th Monaco Energy Boat Challenge (July 8-11, 2026) brings together 54 teams from 21 countries to compete in sustainable marine technology. The event introduces methanol as a new decarbonization fuel alongside electricity and hydrogen, features international conferences on advanced yachting technology and alternative fuels, and offers €25,000 in prizes for innovation. The competition serves as a real-world laboratory for testing energy efficiency and system reliability in marine propulsion.

SBFFY.title: Weekly share repurchase program transaction details
SBFFY.summary: SBM Offshore reported transaction details for its EUR227 million share repurchase program for the week of July 2-8, 2026. As of July 8, 2026, the company has completed 35.98% of the program with 2,412,578 shares repurchased at an average price of EUR 33.80. The company also completed a US$465 million project financing for FSO Chalchi.

GDDY.summary: OpenMatter Network has joined the Hashgraph Online (HOL) Partner Program as a founding member to develop standards and verification frameworks for secure autonomous AI systems. The company will contribute to the HOL AI Privacy & Security subcommittee, focusing on verifiable compliance, post-quantum security, and governed AI execution across distributed environments.

GDDY.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against GoDaddy Inc., Wise Group plc, and Insulet Corporation on behalf of shareholders, alleging these companies issued materially misleading business information. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased AeroVironment securities between June 25, 2025 and March 10, 2026. Defendants allegedly made false statements about the SCAR program's growth prospects while understating competition risks. The U.S. Space Force issued a stop work order in January 2026, terminated the contract in March 2026, and subsequently announced plans to diversify suppliers using commercial off-the-shelf solutions instead of a single-vendor bespoke solution, causing significant stock price declines.

AVAV.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AeroVironment, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
AVAV.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AeroVironment, Inc. alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding its business prospects during the period from June 25, 2025 to March 10, 2026. The complaint claims AeroVironment understated competitive threats related to the SCAR program and U.S. Space Force modernization efforts, thereby overstating its financial prospects. Investors who purchased AeroVironment securities during this period are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of July 27, 2026.

AVAV.title: AVAV DEADLINE: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AeroVironment, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - AVAV
AVAV.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against AeroVironment, Inc. for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding competition for U.S. Space Force contracts (SCAR and SCN programs). The lawsuit claims the company overstated its business prospects and understated competitive threats. Investors with losses exceeding $100K are encouraged to join the class action before the July 27, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

The deal, announced on June 25, 2026, resulted in ON Semiconductor's stock price dropping 23.66% to $90.65 per share on June 26, 2026, prompting investor concerns.

PTNM.title: Pitanium Limited Notified of Anticipated Delisting from The Nasdaq Stock Market
PTNM.summary: Nasdaq announced on July 7, 2026, that Pitanium Limited (PTNM) will be delisted from the Nasdaq Stock Market on July 16, 2026, unless the company appeals. The delisting follows a temporary trading suspension by the SEC in October 2025 and a subsequent halt by Nasdaq. After delisting, the securities may be eligible for over-the-counter trading.

PLTS.title: Platinum Analytics Cayman Limited Notified of Anticipated Delisting from The Nasdaq Stock Market
PLTS.summary: Nasdaq announced on July 7, 2026, that Platinum Analytics Cayman Limited (PTLS) will be delisted from the Nasdaq Stock Market on July 16, 2026, unless the company appeals. Trading in the company's securities has been halted since October 18, 2025, following a temporary trading suspension by the SEC. Following delisting, the securities may be eligible for over-the-counter trading.

DFDV.title: DeFi Development Corp. to Host X Spaces Event: “DFDV June 2026 Recap & AMA”
DFDV.summary: DeFi Development Corp. (DFDV), a U.S. public company focused on accumulating and compounding Solana (SOL) in its treasury, announced it will host a business recap and AMA session on July 8, 2026. The event will cover treasury operations, capital markets activity, ecosystem partnerships, and Solana ecosystem developments. The company operates validator infrastructure, generates staking rewards, and participates in DeFi opportunities while also operating an AI-powered commercial real estate platform.

THRM.title: Gentherm Announces Date for 2026 Second Quarter News Release and Conference Call
THRM.summary: Gentherm announced it will report its second quarter 2026 financial results on July 23, 2026, followed by a conference call at 8 am ET. The company, a global leader in thermal management and pneumatic comfort technologies, will discuss results with investors via phone and webcast. A replay will be available for one year.

CRMT.title: CRMT Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in America’s Car-Mart, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRMT), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
CRMT.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against America's Car-Mart, Inc. for allegedly issuing materially misleading business information. The company reported a first-quarter loss of 69 cents per share compared to 15 cents per share in the prior year, causing the stock to plunge 18.2% on September 4, 2025. Investors who suffered losses are encouraged to join a prospective class action lawsuit.

AIQD.title: Healing Through Music: $500,000 Investment from BMO to National Music Centre Expands Music Therapy Programs for Patients Across Canada

AZN.title: Physicians and Patients Agree Lupus Care Is Improving, But Both Say Meaningful Gaps Remain
AZN.summary: Despite expanding biologic adoption and evolving treatment strategies for systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), research from Spherix Global Insights reveals substantial unmet need remains. While rheumatologists are advancing treatment strategies and increasing biologic utilization, nearly 80% of patients report moderate-to-severe disease with persistent symptoms and frequent flares. Approximately one-third of biologic-treated patients achieve only partial disease control. Recent approvals like Saphnelo® (anifrolumab) and anticipated approvals like Gazyva® (obinutuzumab) for non-renal SLE are expected to expand treatment options.

AZN.title: Transthyretin Amyloidosis Treatment Market Size to Reach USD 35.10 Billion by 2035, Growing at a 14.64% CAGR | SNS Insider
AZN.summary: The transthyretin amyloidosis treatment market is projected to grow from USD 8.95 billion in 2025 to USD 35.10 billion by 2035 at a 14.64% CAGR. Growth is driven by increased ATTR-CM diagnosis rates, FDA approvals of gene-silencing therapies like vutrisiran and acoramidis, improved diagnostic imaging, and expanding pipeline therapies. North America dominates with 46% market share, while Asia Pacific is the fastest-growing region.

FSV.title: As storm season arrives, 7 in 10 Canadians concerned about extreme weather, flooding, and tornadoes
FSV.summary: A survey by First Onsite Property Restoration reveals that 61% of Canadians fear severe rain and flooding, while 47% worry about tornadoes and severe storms. Environment Canada's summer outlook predicts above-normal temperatures and increased severe thunderstorm risk. Regional variations show British Columbians most concerned about flooding, while Atlantic Canadians worry most about hurricanes. First Onsite recommends preparation and fast response as key to reducing property damage.

GTM.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
GTM.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. alleging securities fraud for making materially false statements about revenue guidance and business fundamentals during the period of November 3, 2025 to May 11, 2026. Following disappointing Q1 2026 results and a $62 million revenue guidance cut, ZoomInfo's stock price plummeted approximately 33% from $6.04 to $4.06 per share. Investors who purchased ZoomInfo securities during the class period are urged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 24, 2026.

GLGI.title: Greystone Provides $24.3 Million in HUD/FHA-Insured Financing for Minnesota Seniors Housing Community
GLGI.summary: Greystone, a leading commercial real estate finance company, provided a $24.3 million HUD/FHA-insured loan to refinance an 86-unit seniors housing community in Minnesota. The permanent financing through the HUD Section 232/223(f) program offers long-term, fixed-rate terms to support continued operations and replace existing debt.

ONB.title: Old National Bancorp Announces Schedule for Second-Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call
ONB.summary: Old National Bancorp announced its second-quarter 2026 earnings release scheduled for July 22, 2026, with a conference call at 10:00 A.M. ET. The company, a top 25 U.S. banking company with approximately $73 billion in assets, was recognized by Points of Light as a member of 'The Civic 50' for the third consecutive year and named the 2026 Financials Sector Leader. Additionally, Old National Bank received Bauer Financial's 5-Star 'Superior' rating for financial strength and stability.

SALRY.title: SalMar – Q2 2026 Trading update
SALRY.summary: SalMar ASA reported Q2 2026 consolidated harvest volumes of 81.8 thousand tons gutted weight across its operations in Central Norway (38.9), Northern Norway (32.6), SalMar Ocean (4.8), and Icelandic Salmon (5.5). The company announced a dividend of NOK 10.00 per share and will release its full Q2 2026 report on August 25, 2026.

LMT.title: Nuclear Fusion Market to Reach $33.77 Billion, at a 13.4% CAGR by 2031 | MarketsandMarkets™
LMT.summary: The global nuclear fusion market is projected to grow from USD 18.00 billion in 2026 to USD 33.77 billion by 2031, at a CAGR of 13.4%. Growth is driven by increasing demand for clean energy, technological breakthroughs in plasma confinement, and expanding public-private collaborations. North America is expected to be the fastest-growing region, with inertial confinement technology emerging as the fastest-growing segment.

TOT.title: Permutable joins TotalEnergiesOn accelerator to test real-time energy intelligence
TOT.summary: Permutable, a London-based market intelligence company, has been selected for Batch #7 of TotalEnergies' accelerator program. Over six months, Permutable will work with TotalEnergies teams to develop real-time intelligence solutions for power and renewables markets, helping decision-makers detect early market signals and risks before they appear in conventional market data.

CBZ.title: Reference Equity Calls on CBIZ to Suspend Share Repurchases and Restart M&A Strategy
CBZ.summary: Reference Equity, a CBIZ shareholder, has called on the company to suspend share repurchases and restart its acquisition program funded with equity. The shareholder argues that equity-financed M&A would strengthen CBIZ's competitive position, reduce balance sheet leverage, and position the company to lead industry consolidation in an AI-disrupted market.

MAN.title: Asurint and Bullhorn Streamline Healthcare Staffing with Integrated Credentialing Management Solution
MAN.summary: Asurint and Bullhorn have launched an integrated Credential Management solution designed to streamline healthcare staffing by enabling centralized tracking, verification, and management of candidate qualifications, licenses, and compliance documents. The solution automates credential tracking, renewal alerts, and document storage to accelerate time-to-placement while maintaining compliance. ManpowerGroup, a long-standing Asurint client, helped identify the need for this enhancement.

TTAN.title: TrussPoint Builds Foundation for Residential Exterior Growth with ServiceTitan
TTAN.summary: TrussPoint Roofing & Exterior Renovations, a residential home exterior services investment platform, has selected ServiceTitan as its operational backbone to support growth across its portfolio of roofing brands including Ridge Top Exteriors, Mario's Roofing, Eaton Roofing & Exteriors, and Runyon & Sons Roofing. ServiceTitan's platform will help TrussPoint scale while preserving local brand cultures and customer relationships.

ONCO.title: Onconetix Highlights Realbotix Partnership with Bloom Services to Launch UK Pilot Using Humanoid Robots to Combat Elderly Social Isolation
ONCO.summary: Onconetix announced that Realbotix, its pending acquisition target, has partnered with Bloom Procurement Services to launch a pilot program deploying socially assistive humanoid robots in UK care settings to address loneliness among elderly residents. Realbotix has been accredited as a supplier on Bloom's public sector marketplace. The acquisition is expected to close in the second half of 2026, subject to shareholder approval and regulatory clearances.

ZPTA.title: Zapata Quantum to Present at the Global Technology Virtual Investor Conference July 9th
ZPTA.summary: Zapata Quantum CEO Sumit Kapur will present at the Global Technology Virtual Investor Conference on July 9, 2026. The company highlighted recent achievements including a collaboration with NVIDIA on agentic AI for quantum algorithm development, recognition of its quantum-enabled drug discovery research as a Nature Biotechnology Top 10 paper, and a successful $15 million fundraise led by Triatomic Capital.

DXR.title: Daxor Corporation Announces First-Time Exhibition at the 14th Annual Dysautonomia International Conference in The Woodlands, Texas
DXR.summary: Daxor Corporation will exhibit its FDA-cleared Blood Volume Analyzer (BVA) for the first time at the 14th Annual Dysautonomia International Conference (July 9-12, 2026) in Texas. The company emphasizes how BVA provides objective plasma and red blood cell data to improve dysautonomia therapy, representing a shift from subjective symptom tracking to precision, data-driven diagnostics.

GRWG.title: GrowGeneration Joins the U.S. Cannabis Roundtable to Help Shape the Future of America’s Cannabis Industry
GRWG.summary: GrowGeneration Corp. announced its membership in the U.S. Cannabis Roundtable (USCR), joining leading cannabis operators and ancillary service providers to advocate for federal cannabis reform. CEO Darren Lampert will represent the company. The move comes as cannabis moves to Schedule III of the Controlled Substances Act, potentially providing tax relief to qualifying operators and increasing customer capacity to invest in cultivation infrastructure.

BIGY.title: YieldMax® ETFs Announces Distributions on BIGY, RNTY and SOXY
BIGY.summary: YieldMax® announced monthly distributions for three Target 12™ ETFs on July 7, 2026. BIGY (Big 50 Option Income ETF) distributed $0.5290 per share, RNTY (Real Estate Option Income ETF) distributed $0.5031 per share, and SOXY (Semiconductor Option Income ETF) distributed $1.0369 per share. All three funds maintain their 12% target annual income level.
